ety.text: Borrowed from Old Church Slavonic поощрꙗти (pooštrjati), featuring regressive palatalization across "р" (стр > щр). Another example of palatalization across a liquid is found in the conjugation of слать (slatʹ). Compare native Russian заостря́ть (zaostrjátʹ, “to sharpen, to emphasize”), which does not feature such palatalization. By surface analysis, по- (po-) + о́стрый (óstryj) + -ять (-jatʹ). Ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *h₂eḱ-. Compare typologically подстрека́ть (podstrekátʹ).
